structure.unit: Heat, Light, Power, Water and Other Utility Companies Generally

law.catch_line: Suspension of service to sewerage system
law.text: No public utility furnishing heat, light or power to a sewerage system, after receiving notice pursuant to § 56-261 or § 56-265.11:1 from the person operating such system, may suspend service for nonpayment without giving at least ten days' advance notice in writing to the Commission and the Director of the Department of Environmental Quality.
